messages:
Carlos Gomez: Hey team — our production rerank calls started returning 429s around 10:12am UTC. Only affecting rerank, embedding/generate fine. Saw a big uptick in candidate counts from a client rollout. Example error: "HTTP 429: rate_limit_exceeded". Any quick mitigation?

Maya Tran: Thanks for flagging, Carlos. Can you paste the original request body (sanitized keys) and the response headers from the 429? headers like Retry-After and x-rw-ratelimit-* help.

Carlos Gomez: Pasting sanitized request:```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best tutorial on time series",
  "candidates": ["doc_1","doc_2",..."doc_1200"],
  "context": {"user_id": "acct-987"}
}
```
Response headers I see: `retry-after: 30`, `x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 100`, `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-ratelimit-reset: 1718723460`. The client suddenly started sending huge candidate arrays after a client-side change.

Priya Rao: That candidate list size is a big red flag. Our rerank endpoint is charged per candidate and also counts against QPS; large arrays can push a tenant over QPS even if per-token limits look ok. Two immediate mitigations: 1) ask client to trim to <=50 candidates per call, 2) implement exponential backoff with jitter and respect Retry-After.

Carlos Gomez: We tried trimming to 200 and still got some 429s during the peak. Is there a server-side smoothing option? Customer is on dedicated capacity but burst protections exist.

Kevin Li: We can apply a short quota smoothing / temporary throttle bump for the account while we investigate. Before that, can you share a short repro script? We need to confirm whether requests were being retried too aggressively by the client.

Carlos Gomez: Repro steps (internal): 1) Loop 300 requests concurrently from a single IP, each with 600 candidates. 2) No client-side backoff, immediate retries on 429. 3) Observed sustained 429s and then some 500s. I can paste a minimal curl:```bash
for i in {1..300}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d '{"query":"x","candidates": ["id" for j in 1..600] }' &
done
```

Maya Tran: That reproduces the client pattern. Two things I want to call out: A) our rate limiter is per-tenant QPS with small short-window burst smoothing; B) we recently fixed a bug where the rerank input validation didn't cap candidate_count early which allowed some malformed SDK clients to send nested duplicate candidate arrays — could be related. I'll open an internal ticket.

Priya Rao: On infra: logs show a burst at 1718723400-1718723480 from acct-987, approx 12k candidate evaluations/sec. We saw the worker pool hit connection limits and some internal queues overflowed -> 500s after the 429 cascade. I recommend a short config change: temporarily raise tenant qps from 100->250 for 30m and enable stricter per-request candidate limit enforcement.

Dev Support Bot: Action taken: applied temporary QPS bump to acct-987 (100 -> 250) at 1718723600, expires 1718725400. Created ticket INF-3421.

Kevin Li: Carlos, please ask your client to implement two quick fixes: 1) reduce candidates per call to <= 50 OR page candidates in groups of 50, 2) add exponential backoff (base 500ms, max 30s) and respect Retry-After header. Also log x-rw-ratelimit-* headers to diagnose future events.

Carlos Gomez: Will do. Any server-side changes we should expect from INF-3421?

Maya Tran: INF-3421 scope: 1) add early validation to reject requests with candidates > 500 with a 400 + helpful error, 2) enforce server-side hard cap at 1000 to avoid worker loops, 3) add weighted candidate-cost accounting to the rate limiter so very large lists don't stealth-eat QPS. ETA: patch and deploy in next release window (48-72h).

Priya Rao: Follow-up — we found an SDK that accidentally serialized candidates as a string array inside another array (double-nesting), which caused our deserializer to expand to ~10x candidates in some cases. We'll add a defensive sanitizer in the input parser in the hotfix.

Carlos Gomez: Thanks — customer patched their rollout to send 50 candidates with paging and backoff. 429s dropped to zero in the hour after the QPS bump. Please keep INF-3421 on the roadmap and let me know when the validation patch ships. :thumbsup:

Maya Tran: Noted. I'll update you in INF-3421 when the fix is merged and with the release window. Closing this thread after the patch.

Dev Support Bot: Thread closed by Maya Tran at 1718730456.
